topic: What operational challenges arise in managing power distribution across hybrid satellite-aerial networks during peak congestion?
consensus_response: Managing power distribution across hybrid satellite-aerial networks during peak congestion is challenging due to increased energy consumption from higher transmission powers, bandwidth allocation, and potential interference between links. Load distribution is critical, requiring static and adaptive approaches to balance loads. QoS-OSPF with RSVP can lead to resource blocking due to ECMP approaches. Advanced modulation techniques like NOMA can help mitigate congestion by sharing frequency bands. Optical Fiber-based Satellite Interconnect (OFSI) enables efficient power distribution and increased capacity.
